content.text: Jump to content From Wiktionary, the free dictionary See also: remontadą Dutch[edit] Etymology[edit] Borrowed from Spanish remontada. Pronunciation[edit] IPA(key): /ˌreː.mɔnˈtaː.daː/ Hyphenation: re‧mon‧ta‧da Noun[edit] remontada f (plural remontada's, diminutive remontadaatje n) (soccer) comeback French[edit] Etymology[edit] Borrowed from Spanish remontada. Popularized in France in 2017 following FC Barcelona's 6-1 victory over Paris Saint-Germain in the Champions League. FC Barcelona overcame a four-goal deficit in the second leg of their 2016–17 UEFA Champions League round of 16 tie against Paris Saint-Germain to win 6–5 on aggregate, making it the largest comeback in UEFA Champions League history.
